description: Today, Congressman Joe Morelle announced he has been endorsed by the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC (CPC PAC), the political arm of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, as he seeks re-election to the House of Representatives in the 25th District.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY JOE MORELLE FOR CONGRESS bottom of page
title: CPC PAC Endorses Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
